messages:
ana: Dropping a frame for the rollout timeline inspector — small scope: compact inspector that appears when you click a version point. Main decision: show a micro hover preview for mouse, but require an explicit open for keyboard/touch. Feedback?

mike: Nice start. Two product notes: 1) users confuse the allocation number with version ids in narrow sidebars, so make the label explicit. 2) quick rollback access is useful but risky.

sam: Implementation idea: hover preview purely visual (no focus), click/Enter opens the persistent inspector. The persistent panel should be a non-modal region (role=region) with `aria-labelledby` for the header. If we later make it modal for destructive flows we can add role=dialog then.

yvonne: Accessibility: don't depend on hover. For each chip include an offscreen description exposed via `aria-describedby` so screen readers read "Canary variant — serving five percent of traffic". Also bump color contrast for the chips to >= 4.5:1 or treat them as labels with larger font weight and aim for 3:1 if considered large text.

jules: Copy suggestion: change allocation pill to read "Canary — 5% of traffic" (explicit units). For version stamps, append a short identifier like "v42" on the same line separated by a middot so people don't mix up numbers.

mike: For rollback exposure: show a subtle "Revert" affordance inside the inspector (icon + label). Clicking it opens a confirmation modal with a clear consequence summary and a secondary cancel. No single-click destructive actions.

sam: Dev note: for hover preview we can animate translateY and opacity (fast). For keyboard we won't auto-expand on focus; instead Enter toggles the persistent inspector. Inside that inspector arrow keys move focus between chips and space toggles details.

yvonne: Motion/timeout: make the hover preview stay visible for 180-220ms after pointer leaves so users with limited dexterity can move into it. On mobile, disable the preview entirely and only show the inspector on tap.

ajna: Small UX nit: reduce chip horizontal padding by 2px so the compact view wraps less, but preserve 44px minimum touch target at mobile breakpoints.

mike: Also add a small visual separator in the version line for long histories so it's easy to scan (ghost divider, not heavy).

deploy-bot: FYI: feature flag `compact-rollout-inspector` will be enabled in staging tomorrow 14:00 UTC. Monitor `rollout-inspector` logs. :rocket:

ana: I'll update the Figma: 1) hover preview artboard, 2) persistent inspector keyboard flow, 3) sr-only pill copy, 4) confirm modal layout, 5) contrast + padding adjustments, 6) microcopy changes for allocation and version tags. Will post a short checklist for eng PRs.

mike: Good plan. Let's close after PR links to the checklist and accessibility notes. :thumbsup:
